note: formats are modelled on publicly documented export layouts; exact headers vary by account type and are not exact replicas
canonical_sign_convention: negative is money out, positive is money in

applecard_YYYY_MM.csv.amount: purchases POSITIVE, payments NEGATIVE: inverted relative to the other feeds

bank_category_is_discarded: every feed carries the bank's own Category column, as real exports do. The adapters discard it: using it would mean the bank had already performed the categorisation this project exists to perform.
